content:
nina: I opened a small docs PR to add a compact 'Offline installer -> KMS proxy' migration checklist + quick sanity checks for air-gapped installs. Looking for an infra + docs reviewer.

harry: drop the PR link pls and call out any env var/name changes. important to get deprecation wording right.

nina: draft here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5099 (draft). Key items: 1) rename OLD_KMS_PROXY -> KMS_PROXY_URL, 2) new TLS_CA_PATH/TLS_CLIENT_CERT env vars, 3) short SNAT examples, 4) quick curl/python/sdk checks and an MTU troubleshooting note for HSM UDP paths.

leo: good. add a tiny test plan: verify TLS handshake (installer logs), verify key fetch success, run HSM UDP probe if applicable, confirm offline bundle checksum.

nina: adding test-plan bullets under Troubleshooting. also including rollback step: clear KMS_PROXY_URL and restart the installer to revert.

link-bot: automated link-check: broken anchor found in /installers/airgap_kms.md -> #old-proxy-config. Suggested update: #kms-proxy-env.

harry: replace anchor and add short redirect note: "If you used --use_kms_proxy, switch to KMS_PROXY_URL by X.Y.Z. See migration steps." Add planned removal timeline.

ops-oncall: FYI I'll validate the MTU tip and run simple socat/curl checks in staging. Note: some HSMs use CMP/UDP; large packets get dropped when SNAT or PMTU issues exist. Recommend trying MTU=1400 on egress as a first troubleshooting step.

nina: including an iptables + nft snippet and a curl + python probe. Keeping code fences minimal per lint.

nina: ```sh
# curl probe via proxy
export HTTPS_PROXY="http://10.2.0.7:3128"
curl -v --proxy "$HTTPS_PROXY" https://kms.internal/healthz
```

nina: ```py
# python requests probe
import os, requests
os.environ['HTTPS_PROXY'] = 'http://10.2.0.7:3128'
print(requests.get('https://kms.internal/healthz', verify='/etc/ssl/certs/kms-ca.pem', timeout=5).status_code)
```

nina: ```sh
# iptables SNAT example
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
# nftables equivalent
nft add table ip nat
nft add chain ip nat postrouting { type nat hook postrouting priority 100 ; }
nft add rule ip nat postrouting oifname "eth0" counter masquerade
```

leo: also include the minimal Go http client snippet for SDK teams that often use Go: ```go
client := http.Client{Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: http.ProxyFromEnvironment}}
req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://kms.internal/healthz", nil)
resp, err := client.Do(req)
// handle resp/err
```

nina: added. splitting PR into two commits: (A) snippets + checks + troubleshooting, (B) link fixes + deprecation/migration note. will request reviews from @harry and @leo tomorrow. :eyes:

ops-oncall: once PR is ready ping infra and security for sign-off on TLS env var guidance. I'll run the socat/curl checks and post results.

harry: thanks. small wording request: add a short 'What to verify after migration' checklist for support engineers (error log grep patterns, expected success messages).

nina: will add a one-paragraph test checklist with example grep commands. planning to mark ready later today.
